title: EFC External Research Watchlist
purpose: Track external datasets, surveys, and papers that could confirm, falsify, or constrain EFC. Source-of-truth for 'what has Claude already seen'. Agents MUST read this before searching the web so follow-up reports show only deltas.
author: Morten Magnusson

schema.key: Stable canonical ID (arXiv, DOI, or survey acronym)
schema.title: Short human-readable title
schema.url: Primary URL (arXiv abs, journal, or survey page)
schema.date_seen: ISO date when this item was first logged here
schema.date_published: ISO date of publication / data release
schema.ledger_action: Concrete change required in EFC ledgers, or 'noted' if informational

items.title: DESI DR2 Results II: BAO Measurements and Cosmological Constraints
items.efc_relevance: 2.3σ ΛCDM tension, 3.1σ preference for w0wa; supports EFC L2→L3 regime transition and WP4 T(S).
items.ledger_action: Add L2 row to Validation Ledger; update gap theory-background-hz-modification to 'decision-ready'.

items.efc_relevance: Independent confirmation of w0wa preference; bolsters EFC 'LCDM as special case' (α = −0.14 ± 0.21).
items.ledger_action: Cite in WP1 recovery conditions section.

items.title: Dark Energy Survey Year 6: Cosmological Constraints from Cosmic Shear
items.efc_relevance: S8 = 0.798 (NLA); 2.6σ CMB tension validates EFC logged DES Y6 P3 PASS (0.944 ± 0.018) and μ(a) < 1 prediction.
items.ledger_action: Replace preliminary DES Y6 row in Validation Ledger with published values.

items.efc_relevance: S8 = 0.789 ± 0.012, Ωm = 0.333; wCDM: w = −1.12. Direct 3×2pt anchor for EFC perturbation sector tests.
items.ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger (perturbation probes); cross-reference in WP3 Falsification Protocol.

items.ledger_action: Update Stage-IV Roadmap CMB-lensing row; promote Boltzmann-solver gap to blocking.

items.title: Status of the S8 Tension: A 2026 Review of Probe Discrepancies

items.ledger_action: Cite in WP3 Falsification Protocol and Validation Ledger preamble.

items.ledger_action: List in Elevator Pitch 'related frameworks' and compare recovery conditions in WP1.

items.title: DESI Reaches Mapping Milestone, Surpassing Expectations
items.efc_relevance: DESI on track for DR3 / 5-year cosmology release in 2027; pre-registration window for EFC w(z) and f(z)σ8(z) curves is still open.

items.title: KiDS-Legacy: Cosmological constraints from cosmic shear with the complete Kilo-Degree Survey
items.efc_relevance: S8 = 0.81 ± 0.018, only 0.73σ from Planck — upward shift vs KiDS-1000 creates DES-Y6 (low) ↔ KiDS-Legacy (CMB-consistent) bifurcation that EFC must reproduce as footprint-dependent shear response, not a flat σ8 shift.
items.ledger_action: Open KT-shear-bifurcation in Validation Ledger; bind to existing 'Whitening WP4 komponent w5' planned entry; require EFC to match footprint-dependent w4/w5 whitening components.

items.title: SPT-3G D1: CMB T and E-mode power spectra and cosmology (2019–2020 Main field)
items.efc_relevance: SPT-3G alone: H0 = 66.66 ± 0.60 (6.2σ from SH0ES); CMB+CMB σ8 = 0.8137 ± 0.0037; 2.8σ LCDM tension between combined CMB and DESI-DR2 BAO drives preferences for modified recombination / electron-mass variation EFC must either reproduce or rule out.
items.ledger_action: Add regime-matrix row for modified-recombination/electron-mass escape hatch; record EFC native prediction for σ8 and H0 as standalone row in inference.json.

items.title: ACT DR6 final release (endings and beginnings)
items.efc_relevance: ACT DR6 is the final major ACT release — no DR7 exists; DR6 CMB lensing yields S8 = 0.818 ± 0.022 alone, 0.813 ± 0.018 with Planck NPIPE, and anchors the 2026 combined-CMB S8 baseline.
items.ledger_action: Correct internal references from 'ACT DR7' to 'ACT DR6 (final)'; update Stage-IV Data Roadmap CMB-lensing timeline.

items.title: Simons Observatory Large Aperture Telescope achieves first light
items.efc_relevance: SO-LAT now producing science data and UK-SATs deploy in 2026; EFC must lock CMB-lensing and delensing predictions before SO ramps up.
items.ledger_action: Add Stage-IV Roadmap milestone SO-LAT-Year1; open planned KT entry for EFC vs SO forecast cross-check.

items.title: A consistent MOND modelling of the Bullet Cluster
items.efc_relevance: Provides a same-dataset MOND benchmark on 1E 0657-56; EFC's entropy-sourced lensing must be compared head-to-head against this MOND fit and must not reduce to pure MOND in the cluster regime.
items.ledger_action: Add external-comparison row to regime-matrix; ensure EFC Bullet-Cluster KT reports delta-chi2 vs this MOND baseline, not only vs LCDM.

items.efc_relevance: Shows gravitational force law in BFSS-style matrix theory equals an entropic force from thermal fast/slow mode separation — microphysical underpinning for the class of theories EFC sits in.
items.ledger_action: Cite in EFC_White_Paper_Series theory-foundations section; add evidence-register entry under theory/emergent-gravity.

items.efc_relevance: Introduces a Gauss-Bonnet-based Topological Calibration Principle that constrains deviations from extensivity in emergent-gravity settings, directly overlapping EFC's graph-topological entropy / area-law diagnostics (efc_information_capacity_vs_S).
items.ledger_action: Open structural-constraints row: EFC must pass the topological calibration bound; verify efc_information_capacity_vs_S data lies inside its non-extensivity window.
